##### Project general facts

Miorah by Zoya is a boutique low-rise residential development with a modern architectural identity. Designed to appeal to young professionals and families alike, it is conceived for long-term living rather than high density, combining private living with social interaction through thoughtfully planned shared spaces.

Rooftop lifestyle zones, fitness areas and communal facilities create an atmosphere that feels contemporary, social and relaxed. Every shared space is arranged to encourage connection between residents while maintaining a sense of privacy and comfort within a compact residential setting.

Interiors reflect a refined, contemporary style expressed through warm neutral tones, textured wall finishes and elegant lighting accents throughout the residences and common areas. Living spaces feature clean lines, soft fabrics and carefully layered materials, kitchens are fully integrated with modern cabinetry, stone-look countertops and built-in appliances, and residences are delivered fully furnished with coordinated furniture, lighting and décor.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai South is a strategically planned district in the southern part of Dubai, conceived as a major hub for economic, commercial and logistics activity. Its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, one of the world's largest airports by cargo volume, makes the district a key player in the global logistics and aviation sectors.

Dubai South is home to the Expo City Dubai legacy district, which offers residential communities, educational institutions and recreational facilities alongside world-class event infrastructure. Green initiatives, eco-friendly urban planning and energy-efficient buildings underline the district's commitment to sustainable living.

Dubai South is a thriving business and residential hub that attracts both international and local investors. Its strategic location, state-of-the-art infrastructure and diverse range of opportunities make it a compelling destination for end users and investors alike, supported by the ongoing economic diversification of Dubai.
